title: ticfac should own the operator surfaces tk dropped without replacement: factory webhook, herdr paint/notify
body: Checked against ticfac's actual CLI: factory deploy/setup/status/dashboard and the cloud run|stop|status|logs|trace|supervisor slice have equivalents, and run-epic owns the wave loop — but tk factory webhook (register/inspect/withdraw the factory's Telegram webhook) has no ticfac command and no setup rung, and nothing in ticfac calls its client's PaneReportMetadata or NotificationShow, so herdr pane badges and blocked/settled chimes — capabilities tk herd paint/notify provided and the still-shipped herdr-ticks plugin expects — have no replacement. The wire methods already exist in ticfac's copied client (internal/herd/client/methods.go:597,734); what is missing are callers and commands. tk herd guard and tk herd plugin also have no equivalent.
